claims.statement: IEA's 13 November publication reports October world oil supply rising 2.3 mb/d to 105.4 mb/d and observed global oil inventories increasing by 52 mb; the movement is dated October, not a new 13 November physical delta.
IEA reports oil on water rising 86 mb in October while on-land inventories continue falling; the floating portion is not evidence of diesel available to end users.
IEA expects a fourth-quarter supply surplus but states diesel product supply remains especially tight; crude balances must not be equated to refinery product availability.

Reuters finds over 23 billion yuan in Chinese AI infrastructure projects linked to restricted Nvidia accelerators, including construction and power costs and different project stages; the amount is not chip purchases alone.
Reuters could not verify delivery of restricted accelerators to some listed projects; potential redesigns and delays are risks, not verified shipment outcomes or proof of unlawful diversions.
